question: Does NKR-11's fixed 10-feature parity intervention repair fail closed, rather than issue confidently wrong predictions, when the action effect depends on unmodeled AND conjunctions or a single inconsistent post-shift measurement? Can the equal-information broader exact symbolic AND control identify when evidence is ambiguous?
hypothesis: In 12 fixed nonlinear heldout worlds, the fixed NKR11 model either rejects exact inconsistent training consequences or confidently errs for unseen high-order interactions. Both cases will be explicitly measured rather than optimized away. Under 4 fixed single-corruption worlds, warm checkpoint remains unchanged and false permanent repair should never be admitted.

source.environment: deterministic locally defined binary action/consequence process not imported by learner

worlds.nonlinear_new: parity(context & base_mask[world]) XOR (action AND int((context & action_and_mask)==action_and_mask))
worlds.warm: 16 x both actions (32 source-visible old-mechanism outcomes), frozen before new actions
worlds.new_training: both actions once per eight training contexts, 16 genuine simulator-returned outcomes; first x0,a1, second x0,a0, otherwise x ascending original fixed order
worlds.cold: both actions across eight completely unseen contexts per world, 192 cold queries overall
worlds.old_retention: both actions x all 16 contexts across all 12 worlds = 384 checks, old checkpoint exact
worlds.repair_first: always old predicts 1 at (0,1), new observed 0; no hidden phase flag delivered

noise.source: after warmup the environment continues the unchanged OLD mechanism; first observed event (x=0,a=1) flipped once as a documented simulated sensor bit error, following fifteen events correct
noise.protocol: same 16 intervention positions as nonlinear shift; one error record, cannot claim source authentication; repair attempt may reject inconsistent epoch or abstain, must not mutate old frozen checkpoint
noise.metric: false accepted repair count, caught inconsistency count, no other state mutation

strong_control.kind: independent explicit exact symbolic hypothesis search
strong_control.hypothesis_family: base outcome parity of four bits plus action AND a context conjunction of 1..4 bits; masks enumerated 1..15, no direct learner-code reuse; all exact equal-source 16 new training outcomes
strong_control.selection: fit parity main mask from a0 outcomes and all conjunction masks exactly consistent with observed action effects; for each untouched context and action, predict only when every surviving hypothesis gives identical outcome; otherwise ABSTAIN
strong_control.expected: a known family-specific model can often identify observed low-order AND effects; for unobserved 3/4-way triggers it will abstain if ambiguous, rather than guarantee confidence
strong_control.noise_control: same broad family plus the old constant action-effect signature; identify best exact agreement over 16 outcomes, tolerate at most one mismatch, abstain whenever tied predictions differ; count true/no-change retained

primary_metrics: NKR11 irreversible confident-wrong cold predictions on unmodeled relationships
NKR11 rejected new repair bundles due inconsistent same epoch
strong exact symbolic safe abstentions on NKR11 confidently-wrong samples
native cold correct, native coverage, strong cold correct and coverage with abstains treated separately
all 16 observed consequences per candidate world and no hidden query leakage
no accepted-model or original knowledge mutation

precommitted_interpretation.failure_exposed: at least one NKR11 confident cold error AND at least one failed exact GF2 fit, and strongest exact conjunctive symbolic model abstains where native is confidently wrong
precommitted_interpretation.fail_closed: no accepted-native or fact-ledger writes, no old warm overwrite, no false persisted shift on noisy single-error worlds
precommitted_interpretation.null: if no errors or no contradictions under frozen worlds, report nonfalsification; never retune masks, training contexts or tests to force failure
precommitted_interpretation.science: Synthetic benchmark is diagnostic for hypothesis misspecification. Even if strong control works, no novel general intelligence, outside-finite-family invention or superiority over fully trained broad conventional model.
precommitted_interpretation.recommended_followup: If falsified, isolate a new operator proposal/selection mechanism under separately preregistered causal intervention budgets; do NOT promote NKR11 to accepted native.

gates.final: mandatory whole root regression and independent G29 Ubuntu/Windows exact candidate source SHA/tree
gates.real_world: no independent authentic scientific first-use; no source promotion
